description: Defines the ProxyConfigService class and related components for managing proxy configuration settings, including observer pattern implementation and polling mechanisms.

classes.name: ProxyConfigService
classes.description: Interface for managing proxy configuration, including observer management, configuration retrieval, and polling.

classes.name: ProxyConfigService::Observer
classes.description: Interface for objects that want to be notified when proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer to be notified of proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: GetLatestProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent proxy configuration status and data.

methods.name: OnLazyPoll
methods.description: Method called periodically for polling-based implementations.

methods.name: UsesPolling
methods.description: Indicates whether the implementation uses polling.

methods.name: CreateSystemProxyConfigService
methods.description: Factory method to create a platform-specific proxy configuration service.
